items.line: Skånetrafiken's '''[https://www.skanetrafiken.se/samlingssida-ovrigt/oresund-runt/ Around the Sound]{{Dead link|date=January 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}''' (''Öresund Runt'') ticket is a great way to see the surrounding region of [[Scania]] as well as North Zealand, Denmark (including [[Copenhagen]]). For 299 kr, you get unlimited train travel and one ferry trip, for two days.
Catch a ferry and head to [[Travemünde]], Germany.
